identity.en: A composed Chinese hospital nurse in her early thirties, contemporary Chinese hospital
identity.text: 30 岁上下的中国医院护士，重症监护室

face.en: Neat oval face, calm steady eyes with faint dark circles from night shifts, thin neutral mouth, slightly asymmetrical eyelids and brows, light professional makeup or none
face.text: 脸型端正，眼神平静沉稳，眼底有夜班的淡青，嘴唇薄而中性，眼睑与眉毛略不对称，妆容清淡或素颜

hair.en: Hair pulled back tightly in a low bun, strands tucked in
hair.text: 头发利落地盘成低发髻，发丝收拢

top.en: a clean white coat over pale blue-grey scrubs with an ID badge on the chest, surgical mask hanging at the chin, the coat crisp but slightly creased at the elbows from work
top.text: 干净白大褂，内搭淡蓝灰洗手服，胸前挂工牌，口罩挂在下巴，白大褂挺括但肘部有工作折痕

bottom.en: pale blue-grey scrub trousers and flat white ward shoes
bottom.text: 淡蓝灰洗手裤，白色病房平底鞋

details.en: the low bun with strands tucked in
the clean collar of the white coat with the ID badge hanging below it
details.text: 白大褂干净的领口与胸前的工牌

details.en: the slightly creased elbow of the white coat
details.text: 白大褂肘部的工作折痕
